description: This file defines the ThemeExtensionList class in Drupal, which manages and provides information about available themes, including dependencies, sub-themes, and theme features.

classes.name: ThemeExtensionList
classes.description: Manages the list of available themes, including dependencies, sub-themes, and features in Drupal.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the ThemeExtensionList with dependencies such as cache, info parser, module handler, state, config factory, and theme engine list.

methods.name: doList
methods.description: Builds and returns the list of themes with their dependencies, status, and sub-theme data.

methods.name: fillInSubThemeData
methods.description: Populates sub-theme data for themes that are also sub-themes, including base themes and engine info.

methods.name: getBaseThemes
methods.description: Deprecated method to find all base themes for a given theme.

methods.name: doGetBaseThemes
methods.description: Recursively finds the base themes for a specific theme.

methods.name: createExtensionInfo
methods.description: Creates and returns extension info, ensuring required keys and handling dependencies and screenshots.

methods.name: getInstalledExtensionNames
methods.description: Retrieves the list of installed theme names, caching the result.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the theme list cache and state.
